subject: Sandbox index harvest & pilot agreement - Pinecone
messages:
From: Matthew O'Neill <matthew@pinecone.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Li <legal@pinecone.io>
Date: 2028-07-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot proposal: sandbox index harvest + quickstart

Karthik —

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, Pinecone can run a short sandbox pilot that harvests an existing index from your S3-backed embeddings store into a managed Pinecone namespace so we can validate:

- end-to-end latency for top-k retrievals at 1k qps
- snapshot/restore cadence and S3 spillover behavior
- tenant isolation for the pilot tenant

I've attached a one-page pilot-scope.pdf that outlines the work and responsibilities (engineer hours, RBAC configuration, expected data volumes). High level ask from our side: access to the sample S3 bucket (read-only), an exported mapping of your chunk IDs, and a 2-hour window where your infra team can validate traffic routing.

Proposed pilot window: Aug 7 - Aug 18 (2 weeks with a tech verification on day 3). If that works, I can circulate a short SOW and a DocuSign when both sides approve.

Availability next week for a quick run-through: Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Cheers,
Matthew O'Neill
Partnerships, Pinecone

Attachment: pilot-scope.pdf
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Matthew O'Neill <matthew@pinecone.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-27T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: sandbox index harvest + quickstart

Matthew —

Thanks for the clear summary and the PDF. Sounds promising; a few quick items from our side before we lock dates:

1) Security/compliance: we'll need Pinecone to complete our short security intake and confirm encryption-in-transit and at-rest details. Can you fill the questionnaire (I can drop it in the Drive link)?
2) Data residency: pilot should remain in us-west-2 and any S3 backups must be stored in our account.
3) Isolation: we need a technical note on tenant isolation and namespace-level RBAC (Ben, can you help with specifics?)
4) Commercials: for the pilot, we typically request a no-charge trial with capped egress — if Pinecone can provide credits or a limited pilot invoice that helps us evaluate unit cost, that speeds signoff.

If those are OK, Aug 7 kickoff works for the infra slot. I'm copying Ben (embed ops) for the RBAC and Vanessa (partner eng) for the technical intake.

Karthik
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

Karthik, Ben, Vanessa —

Great, thanks. I'll fill the intake and attach a draft SOW (pinecone-draft-sow.docx) to this thread for your counsel. Short answers up front:

- Security: Pinecone supports TLS + KMS-managed at-rest encryption; we'll provide a brief security note for your intake form.
- Data residency: we can provision the pilot namespace in us-west-2 and restrict snapshot storage to your S3 (we'll push snapshots to your given bucket via an assume-role write grant).
- Pilot credits: we can cover the pilot under a trial credit ticket; I'll confirm amounts in the SOW.

I'll also share a Drive folder with the SOW and a short architecture sketch. Can you confirm who on your side is authorized to approve the SOW (legal/finance)?

Thanks — attaching draft SOW and Drive link.

Cheers,
Matthew

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Matthew O'Neill <matthew@pinecone.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-27T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: sandbox index harvest + quickstart

Matthew —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of technical clarifications before we finalize the SOW:

- Shard topology: for the sample index (~150M vectors, 1536 dims) we'll expect replication factor of 2 and a shard count that supports 1k qps. Do you have a suggested shard sizing table we can reference?
- S3 spillover: during heavy loads, can Pinecone spill to S3 and then rehydrate without manual intervention? If so, what's the expected cold retrieval latency profile (ballpark numbers)?
- Snapshot cadence & retention: we'll need daily snapshots for the pilot and a 30-day retention window. Confirm that snapshot restores are idempotent and we can map chunk IDs back to our original keys.
- Observability: can you emit request-level traces to our tracing endpoint (Honeycomb) or do you provide logs we can ingest?

Ben — can you add any additional ops constraints.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

On 2028-07-27 at 11:35, Matthew O'Neill <matthew@pinecone.io> wrote:

From: Matthew O'Neill <matthew@pinecone.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: sandbox index harvest + quickstart

Vanessa / Karthik / Ben —

Answers inline:

- Shard sizing: attaching a short table in the Drive (also in the SOW). For 150M vectors at 1536 dims we recommend starting with 48 shards, replication factor 2, and we can autoscale further if you hit CPU bottlenecks.
- S3 spillover: yes — we support automated tiering. Cold rehydrate is typically < 2s for partial fetches and 8-12s for full vector loads depending on block size and S3 read throughput; we'll include a micro-benchmark in the pilot.
- Snapshots: daily snapshots are idempotent; restores preserve your original CHUNK_ID -> vector_id mapping when you use the provided manifest. We'll push snapshots to your S3 via the assume-role pattern.
- Observability: we can emit structured logs and traces. We don't push directly to Honeycomb by default, but we can deliver a forwarder or a CloudWatch export you can ingest — we can prototype the forwarder in week 1.

Commercials & legal: I asked legal to provide a redlined SOW; Ava Li will be the contact for any redline/DocuSign flow. If legal is OK, I'll generate a DocuSign link next week with pilot-credit terms and acceptance criteria.

Next steps (suggested):
1) Ben/Vanessa to confirm RBAC and the S3 bucket details by Aug 1.
2) Pinecone to finish security intake and upload SOW to Drive by Aug 2.
3) SOW review and sign-off Aug 3-4; pilot kickoff Aug 7.

If that timeline works, I'll circulate the DocuSign and set up a technical kickoff on Aug 7 10:00am PST.

Regards,
Matthew O'Neill
Partnerships, Pinecone
